data.content:
Here's the fix:

**MTP exit code 8** = "zero tests discovered" — a deliberate behavioral change from VSTest, which returned 0 in that case.

The solution is one line in your `.csproj`:

```xml
<TestingPlatformCommandLineArguments>--ignore-exit-code 8</TestingPlatformCommandLineArguments>
```

This tells MTP to map exit code 8 → 0. Your CI pipeline will succeed when conditional compilation removes all tests, while still failing on actual test failures (exit code 2) or other errors.

**Alternatively**, you can pass it at the command line without modifying the project:
```
dotnet test -- --ignore-exit-code 8
```

If you have many test projects, put the property in a `Directory.Build.props` so it applies to all of them.
